column6: Removing BN/bias decay improved train fit but worsened NLL and missed baseline; all-parameter 1e-4 remains the better width-2 regularizer.

column6: Plateau-only 50% CutMix raised accuracy 0.60 points with 99.10% step retention; class-bearing regional mixing complements RandAugment and hard-tail refinement.

column6: CutMix probability 0.75 crossed the strong-underfit marker and lost 0.15 points despite equal exposure; preserve the validated 0.50 operating point.

column6: Fresh pairs found only 18.91% more image throughput, below the 20% floor; batch 256 did not justify its update loss.

column6: Selective zero-gamma preserved exposure but lowered switch fit by 3.25 points; the weak tail recovered only to 93.80%.
